artifacts.summary: 8-phase implementation plan for classical-only revert of Modal/Temporal/Bimodal with conservative extension proofs

memory_candidates.content: When reverting propagated constructors across multiple logic layers (Modal/Temporal/Bimodal), the layer dependency order is critical: formula types and foundations first, then embeddings, then per-layer bulk restore bottom-up. Per-file selective restore from baseline commits is required when commit history is interleaved across tasks. Conservative extension proofs should be structured as independent phases that can be deferred without blocking the revert.
